## Summary

Describe the public-page, form, dependency, or deployment change.

## Validation

- [ ] `npm ci`, audit, and production build pass.
- [ ] No waitlist records, secrets, precise locations, or confidential partner material were added.
- [ ] Netlify form consent and honeypot controls remain enabled.
- [ ] New third-party scripts/styles are pinned and reviewed.
- [ ] Browser security headers remain compatible with the approved map/font resources.
- [ ] Product language does not imply guaranteed transportation, automatic payments, or guaranteed incentives.
